description: Service selector covers Prometheus metric-enabled services. A service shows unhealthy when any current scrape target is down; no metrics means no scrape data. Use Logs Drilldown for log-only services.

panels.title: Scrape target health
panels.description: Minimum up value across each service's scrape targets. 0 means at least one target is down; 1 means all reported targets are up. No metrics means no scrape data.

panels.title: Service log lines per second
panels.description: No data means Loki has no indexed logs for this service in the selected time range; it does not indicate service health.

panels.title: Unhealthy scrape targets
panels.description: Currently failed targets with their service, job, and instance labels. No rows means no reported failures; the health stat shows No metrics when no targets report.

panels.title: Recent service logs
panels.description: No data means Loki has no indexed logs for this service in the selected time range; it does not indicate service health.

panels.title: Current scrape targets
panels.description: Count of currently reported scrape targets for the selected service, including targets with up=0. This measures target visibility, not service health. No targets means no current scrape telemetry, not a healthy zero.

panels.title: Scrape availability over time
panels.description: At each point in the selected time range, the percentage of reported scrape targets for the service that are up. Failed scrapes count as 0%; missing telemetry produces gaps or no data, not a healthy zero.
